text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
choice_data_list: You didn't sleep well last night, did you?
You couldn't sleep well last night?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I read that popular manga. It turned out to be... pretty scary...
choice_data_list: Could it be that you were too scared to fall asleep...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
N-N-No way! As if!
I-I'm not scared of ghosts in the slightest!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Why am I sleep-deprived...? Right, because I binge-read the whole thing!
Man, it was so good! Wahahaha...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Regardless of the reason,
Shinko Windy doesn't seem to have gotten much rest
due to a lack of sleep...
